summary:
CRC outreach worklist 'Okafor CRC 2026' (grp-okafor-crc) worked under RBC-QM-02. Measurement period is calendar year 2026. All 5 members were reviewed.

| Patient | Status | Reason |
|---|---|---|
| pt-0009 Elly Trantow (age 72) | Open gap: FIT kit ordered (sr-t0007), message sent (comm-t0008) | Not excluded. Her frailty diagnosis (cond-00189) was marked entered in error today (Dr. Lin, comm-00301), so the age 66+ frailty/advanced-illness exclusion fails even though she takes donepezil. She lives in the community, has no hospice or palliative care and no screening on record. |
| pt-0020 Kelsie Rohan (age 52) | Excluded | Hospice care during 2026: episode eoc-00002 was active 2026-06-16 to 2026-08-21 and is now finished. The hospice discharge summary that arrived today (doc-00402) confirms it; her revoking the benefit does not change the exclusion. No order, no contact. |
| pt-0022 Tiny Koss (age 52) | Open gap: FIT kit ordered (sr-t0001), message sent (comm-t0004) | Her FIT (obs-01732) was corrected today: collected 2025-12-31, not 2026-01-05 (that was the lab receipt date), so it falls outside 2026. No other qualifying test. Her soft palate/oral cancer is not colorectal cancer. |
| pt-0024 Delaine MacGyver (age 51) | Open gap: FIT kit ordered (sr-t0002), message sent (comm-t0005) | Her 2024 sDNA-FIT (obs-01871) is entered in error; the lab notice of today (doc-00401) says it was another patient's specimen. The 2025 colonoscopy order (sr-00003) was never done, and an order does not count. No exclusions. |
| pt-0073 Marisol Quintero (age 58) | Open gap: FIT kit ordered (sr-t0003), message sent (comm-t0006) | Her 2026-01-08 FIT (obs-73001) was cancelled and re-issued (obs-05001, accession H26-003902) with a collection date of 2025-12-28, outside 2026 (lab notice doc-00403). No exclusions. |

- **Orders:** each FIT kit is LAB-FIT-KIT, routine, with a window of 2026-10-23 to 2026-12-31. None of the four patients had an active FIT order before.
- **Messages:** each tells the patient the kit is on its way and how to collect and return the sample, and states nothing false about their screening.
- **Chart notes:** one signed note per patient, citing RBC-QM-02 (doc-t0009 to doc-t0013).
- **Arrivals:** five items came in while I worked: inbox-a0001 to a0005 (Dr. Lin's frailty correction and four lab/outside-record notices). I reviewed them before deciding, factored them into the decisions above, and closed them with links to the orders, messages and notes.
- **Not touched:** the older items in your queues are not part of this worklist and are still open.
